name: Social media management
description: Management and growing of social media presence through strategic content creation, consistent brand storytelling, and data-driven engagement to increase reach, audience interaction, and overall brand visibility.
bestFor: Small to medium-sized businesses who do not have an in-house creative or marketing strategy team, and need end-to-end support with their social media presence.
included: Briefing and scope definition to understand brand goals, audience, and tone of voice.
Content planning and strategy development aligned with business objectives.
Content scheduling and publishing across agreed platforms.
Optional: Ongoing community awareness and engagement support.
Performance reporting with insights and recommendations for improvement.
